title: Lead with the buyer’s useful result
recipe: Name the action or result the buyer wants, then the relevant service and context.
client_evidence_needed: Evidence that the service can reasonably help with this outcome.
avoid: Do not replace clarity with vague transformation or promise a guaranteed end result.

evidence.anchor: Keep Your Home Cool On Hot Summer Days

title: Make the next action worth taking
recipe: Action + named deliverable + necessary next-step detail. Choose the deliverable the business actually supplies.
client_evidence_needed: Actual brochure, estimate, menu, candidate shortlist, consultation or assessment and its delivery terms.
avoid: Do not invent a lead magnet, free offer, price or turnaround to imitate a reference.

evidence.anchor: View Our Full Range Of Stone Products
Up Front Security Guard Pricing & Service Details
Get Our Stand-Up Desk Brochure Now
Up Front Job Pricing Over The Phone

title: Explain why the benefit is plausible
recipe: Capability or method → what it changes → why that matters to this buyer.
client_evidence_needed: Source describing the actual method and the limits of its effect.
avoid: Do not use a technical name as proof by itself or infer efficacy from marketing language.

evidence.anchor: It allows rainwater to filter through
eliminates manual entry or data retrieval
we act as your local HR department

title: Finish the feature with a practical consequence
recipe: For each capability answer: which task becomes easier, which problem is reduced, or what can the buyer now do?
client_evidence_needed: Verified capability and a reasonable, qualified consequence.
avoid: Do not add speed, savings, safety or certainty beyond the evidence.

evidence.anchor: User Experience Focus To Improve Site Efficiency
Manage, Store & Centralise All AP Documents In One Place
Save Time And Money On Hiring A Writer
Systemize and standardize your documentation processes

title: Explain the next decisions and responsibilities
recipe: Start action → decision or assessment → delivery; use as many steps as the real process needs.
client_evidence_needed: Actual business workflow, customer responsibilities and next contact.
avoid: Do not force three steps or describe internal administration that does not help the buyer.

evidence.anchor: Determine The Perfect Mesh For Your Home
What Happens Next: Our Proven Process

title: Answer a specific buying risk
recipe: Name the uncertainty and explain the concrete policy, process or evidence that addresses it.
client_evidence_needed: Documented pricing terms, service scope, migration plan, cancellation rule, support or other relevant fact.
avoid: Do not create a guarantee, a no-risk promise or universal no-obligation claim.

evidence.anchor: WITHOUT Migration Issues Or Costly Downtime

title: Put proof beside the claim it supports
when_to_use: Hero, service benefits, process and final offer
recipe: Choose a short attributed experience that answers the current objection; preserve original meaning.
client_evidence_needed: Matching original review, customer, service context, and source.
avoid: Do not turn a one-off experience into a universal promise or mix reviewer identities.

title: Write to an actual comparison decision
recipe: Name the options the buyer is considering and the criteria that determine a suitable choice.
client_evidence_needed: Evidence about each compared option, with dates and matching scope.
avoid: Do not invent competitor weaknesses or assume every visitor knows the competitor.

evidence.anchor: Looking For A Better Value Alternative to IT Glue?
You don't have to buy the newest model

title: Let the reader inspect the comparison
recipe: Use relevant like-for-like dimensions and supported values; explain limitations or missing evidence.
client_evidence_needed: Comparable current specifications, terms and source attribution.
avoid: Do not use empty competitor cells or unsourced preference percentages as proof.

title: Recognize the situation that brought the buyer here
recipe: Name a specific project, event, trigger or problem that the service addresses.
client_evidence_needed: Client audience context or clearly labelled research inference.
avoid: Do not assume private circumstances or add emotionally charged details without grounding.

evidence.anchor: Looking To Expand Your Business Operations To Asia?
Struggling To Keep Track Of Your IT Documentation?

title: Help the buyer recognize the right fit
when_to_use: Services, use cases, FAQs, product selection
recipe: Offer distinct use cases or methods, explain who each suits, and retain exclusions.
client_evidence_needed: Service boundaries, options, eligibility and selection process.
avoid: Do not broaden the business’s service area or capabilities for market coverage.

evidence.anchor: a flexible space for work and play
set up to fit your needs
Am I a good candidate for Invisalign?
See If Your Situation Is A Good Fit

title: Make a desired after-state imaginable
when_to_use: Planned projects, events, design and career offers
recipe: Describe a concrete use or experience the buyer is working toward, then connect it to the service.
client_evidence_needed: Supported service outcomes and buyer priorities.
avoid: Do not promise financial appreciation, employment, health or emotional outcomes without support.

evidence.anchor: Brings Your Storybook Wedding To Life
Kickstart Your Career As A Commercial Pilot

title: Group distinct benefits without repetition
when_to_use: Multi-use products and concise hero support
recipe: Select two or three genuinely different consequences; explain each later where needed.
client_evidence_needed: A separate basis for every benefit.
avoid: Do not turn a headline into a list of every objection or repeat synonyms as new benefits.

title: Name the actual problem clearly
when_to_use: Urgent services and high-intent local search
recipe: Service/problem + relevant place or audience + an accurate next step.
client_evidence_needed: Scope, service area and genuine availability.
avoid: Do not invent emergency coverage, instant response or permanent resolution.

evidence.anchor: BEAT THE HEAT WITH HVAC SERVICES
some rooms hot and some rooms cold

title: Let personality follow the client
when_to_use: Distinctive brands and lighter purchase contexts
recipe: Use a restrained phrase or motif grounded in the brand while keeping the offer clear.
client_evidence_needed: Client-approved tone or repeated source-brand cues.
avoid: Do not make every business humorous or import another brand’s promotion.

title: Organize a real method into a clear explanation
recipe: Use the client’s actual named method or describe its steps plainly. Explain what each achieves.
client_evidence_needed: A real documented process and the actual naming rights/context.
avoid: Do not invent proprietary methods, credentials or branded frameworks to imply expertise.

title: Acknowledge concern without increasing fear
recipe: Recognize uncertainty, explain the service calmly, and make the first conversation understandable.
client_evidence_needed: Audience research and the professional scope of the service.
avoid: Do not diagnose, stigmatize, promise recovery or intensify distress to drive response.

evidence.anchor: It's Hard to Ask for Help

title: Explain what the first conversation accomplishes
recipe: State what will be discussed, what the visitor can learn, who they will meet and what happens afterward.
client_evidence_needed: Actual consultation duration, cost, format, participants and scope.
avoid: Do not call a sales conversation an assessment or promise expert advice it will not provide.

evidence.anchor: What happens in the free consult?
What happens in your free 15-minute consult?

title: Offer an assessment when fit is uncertain
recipe: Invite the visitor to check suitability and explain the assessment path.
client_evidence_needed: Valid eligibility process and accurately described limits.
avoid: Do not imply the visitor qualifies or will be approved before assessment.

title: Reject stale names and service fragments
recipe: Compare every brand, service, location, number and testimonial with the current client brief.
client_evidence_needed: The current client facts and traceable source records.
avoid: Never assume repeated source text is correct merely because the design looks finished.

evidence.anchor: Why Choose Our Regenerative Therapy Over Surgery?

title: Replace interchangeable marketing language
recipe: Replace an abstract aspiration with a concrete buyer job, deliverable, service mechanism or supported result.
client_evidence_needed: Specific facts from the business and customer research.
avoid: Do not substitute another vague slogan or remove useful brand character.

evidence.anchor: Ready to empower your financial journey?
